A dialogue of two.

What they say goes in the prompt's «Lines»: who (by a feature, as in the prompt: «The woman in the red scarf»), how and what, in your language. The line takes its own row in the timeline by itself, the voice goes into the sound. The scene's «Prompt with lines» shows what H3 will get.
